patterns.name: pure02_staircase4
patterns.geometry: Doubly occupied row lengths (4,3,1,0), each row filled from x=1.

patterns.name: pure02_notched_stripe4
patterns.geometry: Start with columns x=1,2 doubly occupied; move the doubly occupied cell (1,1) to the empty cell (3,2).

patterns.name: pure02_alternating_x
patterns.geometry: Doubly occupy odd x and empty even x; invariant along y.

patterns.name: pure02_alternating_checker
patterns.geometry: Doubly occupy cells with x+y even and empty cells with x+y odd.

protocol: Independent NumPy Bloch Hamiltonian; test rank(V_negative^dagger P)=dim(H_negative) and rank(V_nonpositive^dagger P)=m^2 in every actual finite-size momentum block. Independently obtain accessible energy from cumulative spectral-rank increments. No entropy data or fits are read.
selection: Two separate geometry-defined candidate families, with first rank-accessible candidate in each: staircase rows(4,3,1,0); width-two stripe with one cell exchange, destinations(3,1) then(3,2). Selected candidates were checked at L12,24,36 before any entropy run; full requested sizes are audited here.

inequivalence.reason: Any translation or space-group operation of the HoneyComb120 hopping graph preserves the degree histogram of the occupied induced nearest-neighbour subgraph. Particle-hole complementation exchanges occupied and empty histograms. The unordered pairs of histograms differ for all four m4 patterns, proving that neither new example is a spatial-symmetry/complement copy of either old example or of the other new example. This graph invariant is stronger than checking a selected list of coordinate transformations.

interpretation: The two m4 examples are ground-accessible at all listed checked sizes, not an unproved all-L theorem. Both alternating m2 controls are strictly blocked and must be evolved with exact spectral support; their accessible infinite-time states are excited states, not equilibrium ground states.
